result.title: Consistency Learning and Distillation for One-Step MIMO-OFDM Channel Estimation
result.summary: Iterative neural channel estimators can improve recovery under pilot contamination, but repeated network evaluations increase inference cost. This paper develops observation-anchored consistency and Consistency Mid-Training (CMT) estimators for one-step channel estimation in multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems. Both estimators refine pilot-derived least-squares channel estimates in the delay-beam domain. Consistency learning couples endpoint predictions along noisy-to-clean paths. CMT then refines a compact consistency-trained student to predict a flow-matching teacher's endpoint from intermediate trajectory states. Across the evaluated SNR range, the compact CMT student reduces uncoded symbol error rate (SER) by 9.6-20.2% relative to the one-step flow-matching baseline (0.44-0.98 dB in logarithmic SER reduction), while using 74.5% fewer parameters and 73.0% fewer network multiply-accumulates.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究 MIMO-OFDM 信道估计中把迭代神经估计器压缩为一步推理，提出观测锚定的一致性学习与 Consistency Mid-Training，利用流匹配教师轨迹的中间状态蒸馏出紧凑学生模型，在显著减少参数与计算量下降低误符号率。
AI.relevance_reason: 「从轨迹中间状态学习端点预测」的一致性蒸馏思路，可能为 LVR 中把多步迭代推理压缩为少步或一步 latent 状态更新、以及轨迹监督的贡献分配提供方法线索，但任务属无线信道估计，迁移可行性需核查。
